what: live-review-wake '[RUN cancelled]' alert noise. MEASURED 2026-11-20: 5 'RUN cancelled live-review-wake' high-severity alerts (16:12Z to 17:13Z). The workflow runs on cron */5 with concurrency group live-review-wake and cancel-in-progress: false (live-review-wake.yml:24,37-39). GitHub keeps at most ONE pending run per group, so when a run takes more than 5 min, the next pending run is superseded and reported as 'cancelled'. That is expected behaviour, not a missed wake: wakes posted normally at 16:07Z and 16:29Z. Cost: it teaches readers to ignore red run-failure alerts. TO DECIDE: treat 'cancelled' on this workflow (concurrency supersession) as info rather than a high run-failure alert, or shorten runs below the cron period. It must add no gate and must not hide a real failure.
